items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: We had one boy, Joe Sprott. He could show up that slide with him.

ctx.x: So, it's the only one thing that was hard for me, like, whether it's Lydon or something, that thing, and I could play, but not good. We had one boy, Joe Sprott. He could show up that slide with him. It was pretty. They were like a trampoline. Mm-hmm.
